equation: Tm = T0 + sum_(i<j) xi*xj*[b0 + b1*E_strain,ij + b2*E_chem,ij]
notes: O(-II) is used only as a conventional formal oxidation-state assignment for neutrality/reference-state matching.
The model does not interpret formal oxidation state as actual local atomic charge.
For two-cation HfO2-rich oxygen-vacancy compositions, OxiMelt can report an OOF-calibrated family estimate using the frozen binary residual profile.
For predeclared three-cation HfO2-rich oxygen-vacancy compositions, OxiMelt can apply the frozen family-specific binary-OOF residual transfer when support coverage is sufficient.
The Hf-family residual correction is not a general oxygen-vacancy thermodynamic correction.

hf_local_transfer.scope: two-cation Hf-family OOF calibration and three-cation Hf-family residual transfer
hf_local_transfer.binary_output_semantics: OOF-calibrated family estimate; not an independent external-validation prediction
